_comment: Regression gate floors. Set slightly below frozen baselines so noise doesn't flap the gate but real regressions fail it. Raising a floor is fine; lowering one requires a documented reason.

scorer._reason: formal baseline 0.94; observed temp-0 run variance of 1-2 case flips (0.92-0.94), floor set below the variance band so the gate catches real regressions without flapping
